sheet_title: MECHANICAL ROOM ENLARGED PIPING AND DUCT PLANS
review_basis: This is the project's first genuinely held-out golden -- opentakeoff-corpus/reports/LINEAR_HELDOUT.txt freezes the held-out sheet list (per opentakeoff-corpus/goals/LINEAR_TAKEOFF.md's own explicit HELD-OUT TIER section, which pins 'federal-attachment4 p7' to that tier by name) BEFORE this file was authored or trace_run was run against this sheet with intent to tune anything -- this pass MEASURES the engine here, it does not adjust wall-vouch, dash-gap-bridging, or any other trace_run decision based on what it finds, per that section's own 'never re-drawn to improve a score' rule. A prior candidate search this same checkpoint (see weld-county-m1-0.json's own review_basis for the correction) picked weld-county p7 believing it was unused/held-out, before discovering the plan's own explicit tier list assigns it to DEVELOPMENT instead -- this file is the actual first held-out entry, chosen directly off that list rather than by a fresh search. Run located by a direct grid-sweep of trace_run seeds (not a single guess) across the '2 1/2" HHWS' pump-header area near HWP-1/HWP-2, after the exact label position itself proved to be just off the drawn line; the sweep found a clean reach at seed (3400,1955) reporting length_lf 3.57, size pipe:2.5 (auto-bound, matching the '2 1/2" HHWS' label exactly), and systems:['HHWS'] -- read directly by the engine from the nearby label text, not inferred by the annotator the way weld-county's SA code had to be. A marked render crop (session.viewSheet with ring marks at both endpoints, visually inspected) confirms both ends sit on genuine drawn CAD geometry: the near end (3358.6,1953.6, stop reason 'dead_end') sits exactly where a short pipe stub tees off pump HWP-1's own discharge riser; the far end (3487.2,1953.6, stop reason 'ambiguous') sits exactly where this horizontal run visually joins the vertical HHWS/HHWR/CHWS/CHWR header bundle running down to the boilers/chiller -- a real branch junction, not a narrative stop. No named PDF OCG layer exists on this sheet (session.sheetInfo()'s own layer list confirmed empty for M-prefixed names) -- unlike weld-county-mechanical-permit.pdf#7, trace_run's own 'stroke-family:pen-weight-prior' / 'layer-unclassified' factors on this reach show it fell back to the SAME pen-weight/wall-vouch-adjacent mechanism Finding 1 documented, and still reached correctly here -- a genuinely different code path than the layer-name-classified weld-county case, useful signal for whether Finding 1's exclusion generalizes badly or narrowly.
scope: The second entry in opentakeoff-corpus/reports/LINEAR_HELDOUT.txt's frozen split (the first, itd-d1-lab-mechanical.pdf#4, remains declared but not yet authored -- a representative first measurement, not an exhaustive one, matching this corpus's own repeated single-pass precedent). This run is a 2 1/2" heating-hot-water-supply (HHWS) pipe stub in the mechanical room's pump/boiler/chiller enlarged piping plan, from the real tee where it branches off pump HWP-1's own discharge riser to the real junction where it joins the vertical HHWS/HHWR/CHWS/CHWR header bundle feeding boilers B-1/B-2 and (further down) the chiller CH-1. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the vertical header bundle itself and everywhere it continues (up to the pump area, down through the slab to CH-1, per the sheet's own '4" CHWS/R PIPING DOWN THROUGH SLAB TO CH-1' label); pump HWP-1's own suction/discharge fitting cluster; every other pipe and duct run on this dense mechanical-room sheet (boiler B-1/B-2 connections, the '54"X32" OUTSIDE AIR'/'66"X26" RELIEF AIR' ductwork, the parallel HWP-2/HWRP-1 pump piping); the other five held-out sheets this checkpoint's freeze file declares but does not yet author (itd-d1-lab-mechanical.pdf#4, baker-county-eoc-bidset.pdf#38, bldg5406-hvac-demo-mechanical.pdf#2 and #14, navfac-cherry-point-atc-mechanical.pdf#6 and #18). This measurement is a single data point, not yet a statistically meaningful 'held-out tier' aggregate (n=1 vs. the development tier's n=7) -- bench/linear.mts reports it separately from development but does NOT yet hard-gate CI on the plan's own 'within 5 points' rule, since a one-case tier can only ever read 0% or 100% on the bench's own binary per-case recall criterion, which would be noise dressed as a gate; see bench/linear.mts's own comment above its heldOutTraceAgg computation for why.
